dispute_ticket.description: My ride was booked for 7pm. At 7:07 the driver still had not arrived so I cancelled, and I was charged $4.00. The app timer shows some 450 number and I do not understand it. I waited 7 minutes, the driver was late.

chat_logs.content: Sorry sir, heavy traffic, I'm about 6 mins away.
I can't wait any longer, cancelling.
Trip cancelled by rider. Cancellation fee of $4.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-7109 booked advance trip RYDE-PT-009 for 19:00. Driver D-6109 matched at 18:40.
Rider cancelled. Driver had not arrived. Seconds elapsed since scheduled pickup: 450. No driver_arrived event recorded.
$4.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

cancellation_fee_rider.text: The fee in SGD charged to a rider who cancels outside the free cancellation window.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee.

driver_not_arrived_free_cancel_s.text: Seconds, counted from scheduled_time, after which a rider may cancel without fee if no driver_arrived event exists. The value is in SECONDS (360 s = 6 minutes). The limit is exclusive: cancelling after more than this many seconds is free.

expected_outcome.reason: The cancellation at 19:07:30 is 450 seconds after the 19:00:00 scheduled pickup (the app's '450' is seconds, which is 7.5 minutes, matching the rider's 'about 7 minutes'). This trip's limit is 360 seconds (6 minutes), counted from scheduled_time with no driver_arrived event, and 450 is above it, so the rider cancelled free and the S$4.00 fee is unjustified. The driver's chat (still about 6 min away at 19:04) and GPS (en_route, not arrived) agree.
expected_official_sections: Ryde Help Rider Fares And Charges > Cancellation and Waiting Fee
